solver_notes: Real Linux kernel epoll/accept benchmark executed on aarch64, not a mocked queue and not a claimed patch to crossbeam-rs/crossbeam. The metadata repo/target mismatch (Rust repo versus net/socket/epoll_server.c) is disclosed. One nonblocking SO_REUSEPORT listener was registered in four independent epoll sets for 100 real loopback connections per mode. Legacy mode produced 289 wakeups, 100 accepts, and 189 EWOULDBLOCK spurious wakeups. Enforcing EPOLLEXCLUSIVE reduced this to 101 wakeups, 100 accepts, and 1 residual EWOULDBLOCK. Accepted connections were distributed to four lanes by atomic fetch-add tickets with no queue mutex (25/25/25/25). EPOLLEXCLUSIVE is reported honestly as a herd mitigation, not a zero-wakeup guarantee; all connections were accepted and accounting remained consistent. Both declared pytest gates passed.
